blocks: A paraphonic SawX stab: the main envelope opens the closed low-pass filter on each note and closes it again, with no sustain. The Cycling Envelope pushes Saw Mod, and key position and pressure open the filter further.

In GitP/A/Session/26/11/22-Sun, Tactile Techno is on the third Launchpad/Sequencer track and is reshaped heavily while its take records, from 02:20 to 04:08. The session MIDI records Attack and Decay/Release from 02:51. Next come the Cycling Envelope's Amount, Fall, Rise and Hold by 03:21. Then Shape, Timbre and Wave move from 03:33 to the end of the take; on SawX these knobs set Noise, Shape and Saw Mod.
The October capture predates these edits, so it documents the factory starting point rather than the sound in the episode.

Model: Harm. Microfreak/UG/06 Dig Osc/03 Types/16 HARM
Low-pass filter. Saved cutoff: 0.000; resonance: 0.798. Microfreak/UG/07 Filter/01 Modifying Sound/01 Low Pass Filter
Main envelope: attack 0.000, decay/release 0.281, sustain 0.104. Amp Mod is on, so the main envelope controls loudness. Microfreak/UG/09 Envelope Gen/03 Envelope Stages
Cycling Envelope mode: Env. Stored RiseLvl 0.000, RiseSlp 0.500, FallLvl 0.205, FallSlp 0.000, Hold 0.000, Amount 1.000. Microfreak/UG/09 Envelope Gen/06 Cycling Envelope
Sine, clock sync on; stored division code: 10. Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/01 LFO Shape · Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/02 LFO Rate
Amounts use the signed normalized range −1…+1. Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations
All other saved matrix amounts are zero.

Each note starts high and the Cycling Envelope sweeps its pitch down, which turns the Harm oscillator into a kick. The main envelope opens the closed, resonant low-pass filter for a moment. Play single low keys; the short decay keeps each hit tight.

In GitP/A/Session/26/11/22-Sun, Kick It is on the first Launchpad/Sequencer track and is already looping as audio when the episode begins. That take was recorded before Arrangement recording started, so the session MIDI holds no notes or control changes for it. The October capture documents the factory settings.
